sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's 2025 RUPTL revision accelerates grid-scale solar and storage tenders, directly lifting local EPC and module integrators like CDIA and VKTR's EV-charging infrastructure demand.
US distributed-generation names (SEDG, ENPH) face structural margin compression from Chinese inverter oversupply, making their rallies tactical shorts for ID investors.
Carbon-credit exchange volume growth and JETP-linked financing create a durable premium for Indonesian climate-tech firms with verified emissions-reduction projects.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in VKTR and CDIA on Indonesia's EV-bus and solar EPC momentum; US names (SEDG, ENPH) are oversold bounces, not trend reversals. Rotate into domestic beneficiaries of the 2025 RUPTL and carbon-credit monetization. Trim PLUG on liquidity risk.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rupiah stabilization and easing import costs are restoring gross margins for FMCG players with domestic raw-material sourcing, a durable tailwind as BI holds rates steady.
Palm-oil and agri-linked consumer names (BWPT, BRRC) benefit from structurally firm CPO prices and export diversification, decoupling earnings from weak local demand.
Premiumization and halal-certified product expansion remain underpenetrated growth levers for mid-cap consumer firms, driving outsized share gains versus saturated staples.
sectors.ai: Buy selective consumer names with hard-asset or export leverage (COIN, BWPT, BRRC) on rupiah stability and palm/commodity tailwinds; trim pure domestic staples exposed to weak purchasing power. Rotate into mid-cap growers with volume momentum, avoid index-heavy laggards until Q3 earnings confirm margin recovery.
